# storybranch

> Alpha open-source visual testing for Storybook: capture stories as PNGs, pixel-diff against baselines in git, review locally. Install `@adriangohjw/storybranch` as a dev dependency of the Storybook app.

Storybook must already be running at a URL Chromium can reach. Chromatic `modes` or `viewports` on a story become extra snapshots; both on one story is an error.

Add scripts: `visual` = `storybranch test --url <storybook>`, `visual:review` = `storybranch review`, `visual:approve` = `storybranch approve`. Run `npm run visual` (`pnpm run visual` or `bun run visual`) from the package that has `package.json` and `.storybook/`, or pass `--cwd`.

`npm run visual` exits **1** when a snapshot needs attention. In a terminal: scan time, a status summary, one `->` row per snapshot, and `storybranch review at …` when the review UI is available. In CI/non-TTY: `missing baseline <file.png>`, `pixels <file.png>`, `size <file.png>`, `stale <file.png>` per snapshot. A clean run prints `ok`. Inventory: `.storybranch/report.json` under that package. The **first run** marks every shot as `new` in the summary (or `missing baseline` lines in CI) — that is the baseline set, not a broken install. Monorepos: one `.storybranch/` per Storybook package.

Commit only that package’s `.storybranch/baseline/`. Ignore `actual/`, `diff/`, and `report.json`. Run `npm run visual:approve` only when asked to accept shots. `visual:review` and `--open` are for a person.

Install (npm): `npm install -D @adriangohjw/storybranch`. That runs `playwright install chromium`. If install scripts are skipped (Bun unless trusted, pnpm unless allowed to build), run `npx playwright install chromium`. The published CLI requires Node.js 22.18+.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch#readme): install, scripts, CI, monorepo development
- [Quick start](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch#quick-start): scripts, exit codes, AGENTS.md snippet
- [CI on the site](https://storybook.adriangohjw.com/ci): GitHub Actions recipe (`--build`, `--exit-once`, `--only-changed`, artifacts)
- [CI in the repo](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch/blob/main/docs/ci.md): full workflow notes, monorepos, extra browsers
- [Example workflow](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch/blob/main/examples/github-actions/visual-regression.yml): copy into `.github/workflows/`
- [Agent snippet on the site](https://storybook.adriangohjw.com/agents): copy-paste `.gitignore` and AGENTS.md for your Storybook app
- [How it works on the site](https://storybook.adriangohjw.com/#how): scripts in the Storybook app
- [Chromatic compatibility](https://storybook.adriangohjw.com/chromatic): supported `parameters.chromatic` keys, ignore regions, media features, and parameter inheritance

CI: use `storybook build && storybranch test --build --exit-once`. Pull requests can add `--only-changed`. Do not use `--review` or `--open` in CI.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/adriangohjw/storybranch): source, issues, license (MIT)
- [Review UI demo](https://storybook.adriangohjw.com/#review): interactive mock of the local review UI
